entries.subject: Credible site-control / ownership-interest basis sufficient to know what land is being screened
ownerBoundaries: DPL-11 owns non-planning control evidence; DPL-10 planning site identity remains separate.
entries.claimBoundary: A synthetic assumption can exercise the family but is not real title/control evidence.

entries.subject: Authoritative title extent, precise legal boundary and detailed ownership/title evidence
accelerationTriggers: known third-party strip or title ambiguity capable of defeating the site
applicabilityInputs: site control progresses beyond preliminary screening
ownerBoundaries: DPL-06 owns site-claim structure; DPL-11 owns external title/boundary evidence timing and authority.
entries.claimBoundary: Full title/legal due diligence is normally future-due at SCREENING unless a known title/boundary condition accelerates it.

entries.subject: Restrictive covenants, easements, rights of way, access/service rights, wayleaves and other private constraints
accelerationTriggers: known covenant/easement/access-right/ransom-strip/wayleave issue capable of defeating the deployment
ownerBoundaries: Physical approach geometry belongs to DPL-08B; legal/private access rights remain DPL-11 evidence.
entries.claimBoundary: A physical access assumption does not prove a legal right to use, improve or maintain that access.

entries.subject: Party Wall etc. Act and related neighbour/private process dependencies where applicable
accelerationTriggers: known boundary/proximity/excavation/temporary-access condition makes neighbour/private process decision-critical
ownerBoundaries: Planning neighbour amenity remains DPL-10; private/statutory neighbour process remains DPL-11.
entries.claimBoundary: Registry coverage does not determine Party Wall applicability or create neighbour rights/consents.

entries.subject: Public sewer location/depth/capacity, connection rights, undertaker process, build-over/diversion/easement constraints
accelerationTriggers: known sewer route/capacity/easement/build-over condition plausibly capable of defeating the deployment
ownerBoundaries: Part H technical compliance remains DPL-09; DPL-08C owns building↔site water interface; planning SuDS policy remains DPL-10.
entries.claimBoundary: Street-context sewer assumption is not connection/capacity/easement evidence and does not discharge Part H.

entries.subject: Electricity, water, data and other utility capacity, exact routes, connection feasibility, diversions and rights/easements
accelerationTriggers: known capacity/network/easement/route issue plausibly capable of defeating the deployment
ownerBoundaries: DPL-08 owns architectural utility-entry/interface freedoms; external network capacity/routes/rights remain DPL-11 evidence.
entries.claimBoundary: Assumed street-context utility availability is not provider-confirmed capacity, route or connection-right evidence.

entries.subject: Ground profile, bearing, groundwater, contamination, ground gas/radon, buried obstructions and material tree-ground interaction
accelerationTriggers: known tree/ground/mining/contamination/groundwater/gas condition plausibly capable of defeating the deployment
ownerBoundaries: Part A/C technical obligations remain DPL-09; planning tree/TPO policy/status remains DPL-10; DPL-08 owns foundation/site interface boundaries.
entries.claimBoundary: Registry coverage cannot prescribe foundation type or infer ground adequacy from absence of evidence.

entries.subject: Physical flood, surface-water, groundwater and site-water condition outside planning-policy abstraction
accelerationTriggers: any known flood/water source identifies a potentially fatal or strongly geometry-shaping condition
applicabilityInputs: detailed modelling/investigation only when due or accelerated
ownerBoundaries: Planning flood/SuDS policy remains DPL-10; Part H remains DPL-09; DPL-08C owns water interface response.
entries.claimBoundary: High-level screening family may be due now while detailed drainage/flood design remains future work.

entries.subject: Credible physical site approach/access status and any decision-critical legal/highway constraints at SCREENING
accelerationTriggers: narrow/backland/private/unmade/steep/restricted access or other obvious access condition
ownerBoundaries: DPL-08B owns architectural approach/threshold interface; DPL-10 owns planning/highway policy judgement; DPL-11 owns underlying non-planning access evidence.
entries.claimBoundary: Synthetic physical access geometry does not prove legal, adopted-highway, emergency-service or construction access adequacy.

entries.subject: Detailed temporary access, working territory, scaffold/tower/crane/oversailing/highway occupation and construction logistics
accelerationTriggers: obvious constrained access/working-space/third-party/highway condition plausibly makes construction infeasible
ownerBoundaries: DPL-08 owns architectural maintenance/replacement interface duties; delivery owns later construction method; DPL-11 owns site/logistics evidence at deployment stage.
entries.claimBoundary: Registry coverage cannot author a logistics solution or infer feasible temporary rights/working space.
